scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Deforming hypersymplectic four-manifolds to hyperkähler triples” (preprints/Deforming-hypersymplectic-four-manifolds-to-hyperkahler-triples-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 341 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 92c36602fb496808), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a closed connected oriented smooth four-manifold, and let ω = (ω1, ω2, ω3) be a smooth hypersymplectic structure normalized by (1.1) ∫︂ X ωi ∧ ωj = δij. There is a smooth family of hypersymplectic structures ω(t), 0 ≤ t ≤ 1, such that ω(0) = ω, [ωi(t)] = [ωi] (i = 1, 2, 3), and a positive volume form µ1 with (1.2) ωi(1) ∧ ωj(1) = 2δijµ1. The endpoint forms are parallel and self-dual for a hyperkähler metric.
